method: ISO 15927-3 method 1: I_A = (2/9) sum U10 Rh^(8/9) cos(D - theta) / N over hours with cos > 0 (Blocken & Carmeliet 2010 eq. 5); C_T and W not applied

labels.measured: REAL: measured from ASOS airport observations (IEM), at 10 m on open airfield terrain
labels.factors: C_T (topography) and W (wall factor) not applied (set to 1); relative exposure, not litres on your wall
